"""Build final nine-method tables and native comparisons after actual viewing."""
from pathlib import Path
from v175_postprocess import REPO as repo,ROOT as root,context,read,ref,source,write_once
plan,post=context()
assert read(root/'native-viewing-completion-v1.json')['native_figures']==60
assert read(root/'training-audit-v1.json')['status'].startswith('pass-')
assert read(root/'quality-audit-v1.json')['status'].startswith('pass-')
notes=root/'human-quality-notes-v1.md';assert len(notes.read_text())>300
execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json');paired=read(root/'paired-comparisons-v1.json');audit=read(root/'quality-audit-v1.json')
summaries={(s['kind'],s['condition'],s['cohort'],s['method']):s for s in paired['summary']}
methods=['parent','V161-EMA','V169-EMA','V171-EMA','V172-EMA','V173-EMA','V174-EMA','V175-raw','V175-EMA'];columns=['V143 parent','V161 EMA','V169 EMA','V171 EMA','V172 EMA','V173 EMA','V174 EMA','V175 raw','V175 EMA']
text='# V175 fresh-noise continuation: completed quality\n\n'+notes.read_text().strip()+'\n\n'
text+='[Final evidence and exact sources](results/v175-fresh-noise-matching-final-v1.json) · [Native pixels, source ROIs, checkpoint, noise and display metadata](images/v175-fresh-noise-matching-v1/manifest-v1.json).\n\n'
cells=[];lines=[]
def table(title,specifications):
 global text
 text+='## '+title+'\n\n| Metric | '+' | '.join(columns)+' |\n| --- | '+' | '.join(['---:']*len(columns))+' |\n'
 for label,kind,condition,cohort,field,digits in specifications:
  values=[]
  for method in methods:
   value=summaries[kind,condition,cohort,method][field];rendered=f'{value:.{digits}f}'
   cells.append(dict(kind=kind,condition=condition,cohort=cohort,method=method,field=field,digits=digits,rendered=rendered));values.append(rendered)
  line='| '+label+' | '+' | '.join(values)+' |';lines.append(line);text+=line+'\n'
 text+='\n'
table('Mesh response and actual blank error',[(('Present' if present else 'Absent')+' '+label,'mesh',present,None,field,digits) for present in [True,False] for label,field,digits in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16',6),('signed template gain','template_gain',8),('actual blank RMS','blank_error_RMS_DN16',6),('blank spatial RMS','blank_spatial_RMS_DN16',6),('blank DC RMS','blank_DC_RMS_DN16',6)]])
table('Quiet fields beside detail',[(f'{prior} {label}','mixed-quiet',prior,None,field,6) for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('whole RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet RMS','quiet_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet spatial RMS','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('quiet DC RMS','crop_DC_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Native 512-pixel standalone flats',[(f'{prior} {label}','flat',prior,'fresh-flat512',field,6) for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('spatial RMS','full_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Natural photographic detail',[(f'{cohort}/{variant} {label}','photo',variant,cohort,field,6) for cohort in ['retained512','organic384'] for variant in ['photo-faint','photo-dark'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band response','crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]])
design=read(plan['design']['path']);adc=next(c for c in design['observations'] if c.get('cohort')=='adc-photo256')
table('ADC-only controls',[(f'Photo {label}','photo',adc['variant']['name'],adc['cohort'],field,6) for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]]+[(f'{cohort} {label}','flat','adc-only',cohort,field,6) for cohort in ['fresh-flat512','adc-sloped512'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])



text += "RMS values are camera-RGB DN16. Template gain 1 means exact constructed amplitude; an absent signed mean near zero does not certify absence of false structure. Coarse32 is spatially centered block-mean error. Paired increase/decrease counts are retained. The reused cohort does not establish blind performance or training-seed uncertainty.\n\n"
text += "## Continued training and fresh physical observations\n\n"
text += "The actual V172 step-1000 raw model, Adam and EMA states initialize this continuation at 900 optimizer updates. All 96 neural source files, the 2,088,906-parameter/141-tensor matching network, local physical features/output units, frozen V169 EMA and V143/DINO parent remain unchanged. The original seven-term criterion and its bytes are unchanged; only the training recipe changes. No V174 spread initialization or released V170 weights are applied.\n\n"
text += "Nine additional passes over the retained 1,000 scene/calibration/target rows complete 8,100 new optimizer updates, 900 ADC skips and 32,400 images. Including V172, the model has 9,000 updates/36,000 images on 1,000 unique scene batches. Learning rate reheats to 0.0001 with a 100-row warmup and cosine decay to 0.00001; AdamW, clipping and EMA rules remain. Budget, noise realizations and LR change together, so their individual effects are not isolated. [Original protocol](results/v175-fresh-noise-matching-v1/original-protocol-v1.md).\n\n"
text += "All 1,000 old input bindings are checked. Independent NumPy Bayer sampling and original clean-sensor hashes admit 897 noisy rows per pass for re-noising. Three clipped photo rows, 65/358/543, cannot recover their original unclipped sensor signal from their stored RGB target, so their exact noisy observations/parents are retained. The result is 8,073 fresh sensor batches, 27 cached noisy batches and 900 ADC skips. No source, camera or geometry is rendered again; no original/dataz files are read.\n\n"
text += "Fresh noise uses a stateless local CPU generator per continuation row. Counterfactual members share common Poisson counts and read noise; ordinary members use independent sensor samples. Variance conditioning is computed from the new noisy intensity. Targets, masks and pair units remain training-only. Each fresh batch recomputes its own exact frozen V143/DINO parent; no parent from a different noise draw is substituted. The 27 cached batches retain their matching original parents, and ADC rows skip noise/parent/matching/optimizer work.\n\n"
text += "The first CPU preflight rejects the all-targets-as-clean assumption before any training-data draw. A later CPU binding-shape rejection and a v1 worker import failure are also preserved. The v1 worker stopped before its training claim or CUDA runtime because its snapshot omitted the physical sensor helper. The corrected v2 workspace includes the dependency and passes actual frozen-worker imports, metric construction, strict matching/full-parent/DINO CPU loads and all 54 focused tests, including 18 new cases. The graph/native backward admission inherits unchanged evidence rather than repeating forwards. [Preparation and preserved rejections](results/v175-fresh-noise-matching-preparation-v2.json) · [Frozen-worker readiness](results/v175-frozen-worker-readiness-v1.json).\n\n"
text += "Two cached-parent CUDA replays at different native sizes reproduce their existing fingerprints exactly before training. A real total-row-1008 checkpoint restores model, Adam, EMA and CPU/CUDA RNG exactly, then continues at 1009 without replay. Global RNG remains unchanged because new noise uses local generators. Atomic sampler input gradients retain warn-only nondeterminism; state restoration does not imply a bit-exact training trajectory.\n\n"
t = read(root / 'training-audit-v1.json')
text += f"The final audit checks all 9,000 source/target/unit mappings, {t['training_forward_events_checked']:,} durable parent/matching events, {t['FP32_loss_totals_checked']:,} independently summed NumPy FP32 objective totals, 8,100 inherited clean-mask fingerprints and {t['actual_parent_argument_fingerprints_checked']:,} actual parent-argument fingerprints. All 141 final Adam states are at actual step 9,000, including 900 inherited updates. Both strict endpoint states are finite and all 47 frozen state tensors retain the initial values.\n\n"
text += "The first eight continuation rows retain seven actual fresh noisy batches and their parent arrays; the ADC row uses its old cached data. Independent saved-array checks cover their physical variance, fingerprints and exact common-noise pixels. Later fresh arrays were streamed and fingerprinted, not retained as a complete posthoc byte archive. Seeds, source hashes, observed arguments/output fingerprints and unchanged-source checks cover the other rows; there is no full-array audit of all 8,073 new realizations. No noise or neural forward is repeated by the audits.\n\n"
text += "## Fixed quality, comparisons and execution scope\n\n"
text += "Both final endpoints complete all 822 fixed cached inputs: 1,644 compositions, 1,500 actual matching calls and 7,500 nested samplers. All 1,644 V169 fingerprints replay exactly and all 144 ADC outputs retain V169. All 6,576 actual quality-input fingerprints and durable event/row bindings pass. Zero local supplied variance retains the frozen output; this is not a guarantee for noisy flat fields.\n\n"
text += f"Independent in-process residual addition covers {audit['allcase_inprocess_addition_channels']:,} channels. New full RGB arrays cover 36 selected native cases: 72 RGB plus 72 residuals, 430,196,736 bytes. Independent posthoc metrics/addition check {audit['scalar_checks']} scalars and {audit['independent_native_addition_channels']:,} channels on those arrays. Other outputs were scored/fingerprinted and independently norm/decomposition/addition checked in process but were not retained as full arrays.\n\n"
text += "The nine-method tables include the earlier V161 EMA detail prototype, V169 EMA, V171 EMA, V172 EMA, V173 EMA, V174 EMA, V143 parent and both new endpoints. All 822 old V161 EMA arrays exist on exactly the same noisy inputs/parents/ROIs and identical metric-source bytes. A new array-only reduction rehashes and recomputes them; all 8,038 comparable old scalars match exactly, with no model calls. [V161 baseline reduction](results/v175-fresh-noise-matching-v1/baseline-V161-current-metrics-v1.json).\n\n"
text += "V172 comparisons use its existing audited label-only view rather than the original scores' historical V171 method names. Reversing the labels and native dictionary keys reproduces the complete original record exactly; no prediction, weight or scientific value changes. The continuation plan's original path is preserved and the postprocessing input receipt binds the canonical comparison view. Other earlier numeric comparisons reuse previously audited scores on identical cached inputs.\n\n"
text += f"Decimal arithmetic checks {paired['independent_Decimal_mean_checks']} grouped means. Six existing primary EMA quality forwards additionally retain 30 FP32 pre-tanh offset fields, 102,780,672 bytes. Independent NumPy FP64 reduction binds them to actual inputs/outputs and reconstructs sample positions. These are not retained bit-exact CUDA coordinates, causal distant-information measurements or whole-model receptive fields.\n\n"
text += f"This continuation and quality use {execution['total_new_candidate_matching_CUDA_calls']:,} new CUDA matching calls, zero CPU matching calls and {execution['total_frozen_component_CUDA_calls']:,} nested V169 calls. There are {execution['total_new_full_parent_CUDA_calls']:,} actual full V143/DINO roots: 8,073 fresh training batches plus two cached-parent replays, 32,300 parent images. Sensor construction uses {execution['sensor_Poisson_calls']:,} Poisson and 8,073 Gaussian API calls, with no new source/geometry/camera renders or original/dataz reads. The prior six-input shortcut diagnostic belongs to the preceding V174 work, not these counters. Unit-test draws are separate from scientific training-data counters.\n\n"
text += f"Both corrected CUDA phase owners, the preserved pre-CUDA failed owner and the old-array reducer owner are terminal. No successful scientific prefix repeats. Training/quality CUDA peaks are {execution['peak_training_CUDA_allocated_bytes']/2**30:.6f}/{execution['peak_quality_CUDA_allocated_bytes']/2**30:.6f} GiB. No new full-frame/100MP or ten-second claim is made. Existing MIT and embedded Caffe sampler notices remain in provenance.\n\n"
text += "Disk reserves remain 48/111 GiB local/external plus 0.5 GiB margin; runtime/launch RAM remain 32/52 GiB and CUDA quota 24 GiB. Postprocessing raises the remaining local publication forecast from the original 0.2 to 0.4 GiB to include the larger journal/result copies and comparisons. Original guards, receipt bytes and frozen source remain unchanged. [Postprocessing input/source preparation](results/v175-postprocess-preparation-v1.json).\n\n"
text += "## Fixed native comparisons\n\n"
text += "All 60 figures were actually viewed in 15 original-detail sheets: 48 boards and 12 noisy/restored/exact constructed GT triplets. Every cell is 160×160 native pixels without resizing. Sources/ROIs, checkpoint hashes, physical noise, exposure, camera transform, contrast and anchors are in the manifest. Mesh uses RGGB512, ROI [176,176,160,160], shot0.00128/read variance6.5536e-6, exposure8 and separate contrast1/40 views. Quiet uses ROI [80,176,160,160], exposure8/contrast40; flats use ROI [176,176,160,160], exposure4/contrast40. ISO12800 uses shot0.00256/read variance2.62144e-5. [Photographic credits](fine-mesh-training.md#photographic-credits).\n\n"
text += "Main DSCF3879 ISO6400/DSCF3880 ISO100 covers sky, building, foliage and coarse fence at exposure4. Extra DSCF3842/3835 covers both priors and fine cab windows [206,229,160,160]/[426,189,160,160] in 768-pixel contexts at exposure16, with both camera JPEGs. ISO100/AHD/JPEG references differ in aperture, depth of field, shutter, motion and processing. They are qualitative references, not exact GT or pixelwise scoring targets. Both protected families/JPEGs/siblings stay excluded from training and originals stay read-only and unused. [Main scene](../configs/gfx-qualitative-20231231.json) · [Fine cab mesh](../configs/gfx-green-mesh-20231231.json).\n\n"
text += "The [native-pixel viewer](images/v175-fresh-noise-matching-v1/native-viewer.html) defaults to V174 EMA versus V175 EMA; select V172 EMA for the continuation baseline or V161 harmonic EMA for the earlier detail option. Click the flip tile or press F. [Browser pixel verification](results/v175-native-viewer-verification-v1.json).\n\n"
figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json')
for triplet,title in [(False,'All native comparison boards'),(True,'Noisy, restored and exact constructed GT triplets')]:
 text+='### '+title+'\n\n'
 for item in figures['images']:
  if item['triplet']!=triplet:continue
  text+=f"{item['case']['id']}; ROI `{item['ROI_xywh']}`, exposure {item['exposure']:g}, contrast {item['contrast']:g}.\n\n![Native comparison](images/v175-fresh-noise-matching-v1/{Path(item['image']['path']).name})\n\n"
text+='[Independent publication verification](results/v175-fresh-noise-matching-publication-verification-v1.json).\n'
assert len(cells)==378
report=repo/'docs/fresh-noise-matching.md';report.write_text(text)
write_once(root/'report-bindings-v1.json',dict(status='built-from-completed-audits-and-actual-native-notes',report=ref(report),notes=ref(notes),cells=cells,lines=lines,source=source(__file__)))
print('Built',len(cells),'metric cells;60 actual native figures')
